title: Salubrity
summary: SALU'BRITY, noun [Latin salubritas.] Wholesomeness; healthfulness; favorableness to the preservation of health; as the salubrity of aid, of a country or climate.

inlines.v: SALU'BRITY, noun [Latin salubritas.] Wholesomeness; healthfulness; favorableness to the preservation of health; as the salubrity of aid, of a country or climate.
